name: Hime ∞ Kami 1/2
source:
By the light civilizations bring, the people in shadows are pushed into darker places.... Monsters..., devils..., and humans.... One day, a girl comes to a station. She is a newly employed miko sent to this world. Her name is Kuu....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090109191933/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008869]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
文明带来的光明，将生活在阴影中的存在逼入更加黑暗的角落…怪物、恶魔，以及人类…一天，一名女孩来到车站。她是刚受命来到这个世界任职的巫女，名叫空…

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090109191933/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008869]ErogeShop[/url]]
